title: Course Schedule
description:
There are n courses numbered 0 to n-1. Some courses have prerequisites: a pair "a b" means you must finish course b before taking course a. Decide whether it is possible to finish all courses.

Input format
Line 1: n and m separated by a space.
Next m lines: two integers a and b (a prerequisite pair).

Output format
YES if all courses can be finished, otherwise NO.
hints: Draw each prerequisite as an arrow from b to a. When is it impossible to order the courses?
It is impossible exactly when the directed graph contains a cycle. Detect cycles with a depth-first search or with a topological sort.

Kahn's algorithm: compute in-degrees, repeatedly take a course with in-degree 0, and decrease the in-degree of the courses that depend on it. If you can take all n courses the answer is YES. Cycles can involve more than two courses.

examples.explanation: Each course requires the other, so a cycle exists.
